name: Payy verifier accepted zero-hash USDC burns
summary: Payy L2 admitted UTXO burns of USDC with a zero burn hash, which the UTXO circuit binds to the first input-note commitment and permits only for zero-kind padding notes. The registered recursive Honk verifier accepted the aggregated statements, and two settlement batches depleted the bridge through direct payouts and a reimbursed fast withdrawal.

loss.notes: Three zero-commitment burns depleted 1,918,793.198148 USDC, including the 1-USDC substitutor reimbursement. Subtract 5 USDC of outstanding attacker-supplied deposits. The earlier 5-USDC deposit/withdrawal cancels. No financing costs or subsequent recoveries are deducted.

ageReset.description: VerifierAdded on the bridge registry selected this verifier for the agg_final key 0x0701c58c…787c, replacing 0xb553c325959c8615d9018f00906aec3799b94200; the selection held through the exploit.

limitations: The failing layer is below the published circuit source (constraint translation or proof system of Payy's bb 3.0.0 stack); the specific defect is not independently recovered.

sources.note: Semantic identity/root-cause review. source-1/source-2 debug_traceTransaction(tx,{tracer:callTracer}) shows bridge 0x367c1eaf14aa06b78ce76bd0243297de79d85270 through RollupV1 0x7d8837b547f4fea0053571cb149e845fc58e9b2d STATICCALLing this verifier with verify(bytes,bytes32[]) and receiving true. ABI-decode verifyRollup(uint256,bytes32,bytes,bytes32[],bytes32,bytes[]): L2 heights 33198253 and 33216759; attacker messages are [3,USDC-kind,1828589378132,0,recipient], then [3,USDC-kind,1000000,0,recipient] and [3,USDC-kind,90202820016,0,recipient]. These are actual accepted public inputs, not event placeholders. source-12 fixtures bind the recursive statement: utxo requires burn hash=first input commitment, first input kind=nonzero USDC kind, balance conservation and ownership; common/note.nr permits literal-zero padding commitments only for zero-kind, zero-value notes, otherwise computes Poseidon2. Thus these messages violate the intended statement under the ordinary hash-preimage assumption; no private note entitlement authorizes a zero-commitment USDC burn. The aggregation fixtures enforce message export and zero tails. All 56 deployed final-VK coordinates match fixtures/circuits/agg_final/key_fields.json. Reproduce the recursive key chain from source-12 fixtures/circuits/{utxo,agg_utxo,agg_agg,agg_final}/key_fields.json: parse each hex field, hash in order using Poseidon2 over BN254 Fr (modulus 21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617), width 4/rate 3/capacity 1, initial capacity=input length<<64, additive absorption with zero padding of the final rate block, and first output field. Source-4 pins the permutation constants and upstream test vector; use 8 full and 56 partial rounds with x^5. Expected hashes: utxo=0x2d047af63c0fdcc845dd1fc34eeb0c91d01da8699318d38e86bacc7c6ac4c3de; agg_utxo=0x0d09b358d7924dc34761f3f433962002894cf7caccbede41d290d5f407cf3f04; agg_agg=0x0c4e78cc6dd1d278c1fe04fe32e8e01f86e002f0ca2dd30a13f9a97815128699; agg_final=0x0701c58cb73e870b8da74294bb1a820e346546e4d3cdca393aa84d3716d3787c. These match UTXO_VERIFICATION_KEY_HASH in noir/agg_utxo/src/main.nr, AGG_UTXO_VERIFICATION_KEY_HASH and AGG_AGG_VERIFICATION_KEY_HASH in noir/agg_final/src/main.nr, and the source-6 registry key, respectively. The upstream permutation vector and all four hashes were reproduced. The final creation binary eth/contracts/noir/agg_final_HonkVerifier.bin has a 222-byte creation prefix; after linking ZKTranscriptLib, its runtime matches chain byte-for-byte except constructor immutables. Runtime byte offsets 122,179,287,496,2638,2907,3066,3112,3246,5442,5617,5668,6190,11113,11884 replace zero with 20; offsets 461..462 and 2335..2336 become 03fb; offsets 397..428 become VK_HASH 0x0f8581a994b714ef6fcffeaea9777e69e6bc7c0140a039a23afc764d8e863328. Source files embedded in fixture program.json agree with the corresponding Noir files (formatting excepted). This uses published compiled-artifact provenance, not an independent circuit recompilation. The June 10 advisory https://github.com/polybase/payy/security/advisories/GHSA-fhxc-63vg-9gwr describes a different message-tail flaw; the pinned deployed-key fixture has its zero-tail check. Next for exact mechanism: obtain original inner UTXO/recursive proofs or the project/auditor report and identify the violated constraint. The configured prover submitted both batches; submission is not evidence of key compromise.

Semantic loss review. source-1 USDC Transfer log 524 pays 1828589378132 base units to 0xaa4985dbdabfaca344237d40f7e06c4a0bb57e70; source-2 log 1069 pays 90202820016. source-10 first transfers 1000000 from substitutor 0x7c7e3fd85854be2d95516eda97a808424e717978 into bridge and then to attacker; source-2 reimburses that same substitutor 1000000 for the same zero-hash burn. Count the advance/reimbursement once, giving 1918793.198148 USDC bridge depletion. Other batch recipients are excluded: their nonzero burns are not established as malicious. Etherscan V2 account/tokentx for USDC and attacker, blocks 0..26048000, yields 18 entries and source-9 deposit 5, withdrawal 5, deposit 5. Subtract the remaining 5 attacker-supplied USDC per methodology; the prior 5 round trip cancels, giving 1918788.198148 USDC gross victim depletion at stablecoin par. No fees, swaps or later recoveries reduce this amount. No additional entitlement is inferred from private note balances: the included burns fail the authenticated commitment condition, and the identifiable own contribution is explicitly excluded.

It is not an evidenced earlier exercise of this fault. This is complete history for the demonstrated zero-commitment signature, not proof that every nonzero historical proof was sound. Code hashes at 25101717 and 26044908 match: verifier as structured; library 0xc8e0f3e941dc1290abb48a24747a44e885956e4cc82f6698292b707d89b56de7; RollupV1 implementation 0x4d0ae128df2dcaae123f8802479fc3c4fcd4563b4caedb1ac14759f165323b73. Bridge EIP1967 implementation slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc points to 7d8837b547f4fea0053571cb149e845fc58e9b2d at both heights. Scan Upgraded,VerifierAdded,VerifierRemoved,RootHashUpdated,ValidatorSetAdded,ProverAdded,ProverRemoved over the same full range: only initial implementation/validator/root events at 24475975, migration-root write 24476455, and verifier events 25101230/25101297/25101717 occur. Verified RollupV1 source writes verifier selection only during initialization/add/remove and emits corresponding events after initialization; implementation changes emit Upgraded. No arbitrary storage/delegatecall path bypasses those setters. Direct verifier/library have fixed executable code and immutable linking. getZkVerifier(finalKey) before/after source-6 confirms old b553c325959c8615d9018f00906aec3799b94200 replaced by this verifier, messages_length=1000; pre-exploit 26044908 matches after-state. Age uses that required bridge authorization/configuration activation, later than immutable verifier/library deployments. No separate fault is attributed to the transcript library or bridge parser; they are execution dependencies, not independent defect-bearing targets. Unresolved optional attribution: precise proof-system layer. Public node /v0/{height,blocks?limit=1,transactions?limit=1} at validators.mainnet.payy.network returned 502 on 2026-09-28; explorer legacy asset URLs returned landing HTML. Next: retrieve blocks 33198253/33216759 and preceding batches when the node/archive is available, trace their UTXO proofs and test any earlier nonzero fault witness; reanchor if one is established.

Root-cause review. Compiling noir/{utxo,agg_utxo,agg_agg,agg_final} at source-12 with nargo 1.0.0-beta.14 reproduces the fixture program.json bytecode. Payy's pinned bb 3.0.0-manual.20251030 write_vk (ultra_honk; poseidon2, keccak for agg_final) reproduces all four fixture keys, and the agg_final vk_hash 0x0f8581a9…3328 equals the verifier VK_HASH immutable. The deployed verifier therefore embeds the published circuits. source-10 is Payy's burn substitutor fast-paying the 1-USDC zero-hash burn from committed L2 block 33198792. The substitutor reads node-committed transactions, and the node verifies each UTXO proof natively before admitting it (pkg/node/src/utxo.rs), so the burns entered as L2 transactions, not through prover-side injection. The first-batch zero-hash burn is message 38 of 84, interleaved with legitimate messages rather than in a tail, so it is not the GHSA-fhxc-63vg-9gwr pattern. agg_utxo/agg_agg export and RollupV1 parsing (kind 2: 4 words, kind 3: 5 words) agree. Under the published UTXO circuit, burn hash equals the first input commitment, and that commitment is zero only for kind-0, value-0 notes, while the burn kind must equal the USDC kind. No valid UTXO proof exists for these messages. The failure is below the circuit source, and it is shared by the native check and the in-circuit HONK_ZK recursion that this verifier's key chain embeds. The verifier target remains the knot. The registry write selects executable verifier code, so it is a module-change anchored on VerifierAdded log 271, data word 1.

limitations: The UTXO proofs behind the zero-hash burns are unavailable (Payy node offline), so the specific proof-system or constraint defect is not recovered.
Earliest exercise and campaign scope use a complete zero-hash burn event scan through block 26075925; nonzero historical proofs are not independently reverified.
